Title: Report of the General Manager Planning and Development – Response to 3030 Gordon Operational Review
Topics: Housing & density; Public services; Governance & elections
Motion text: That Council direct staff to send letters under the Mayor’s signature to BC Housing, relevant Provincial and Federal Ministries, with copies to Tri-Cities partners, MLAs, MPs, Tri-Cities Homelessness and Housing Task Group (TCHHTG) and RainCity, as follows: 1. Seeking an update of BC Housing’s progress in implementing the recommendations of the 3030 Gordon Operational Review Report; 2. Outlining the City’s ongoing concerns related to the supportive housing and shelter program at 3030 Gordon Avenue, operated by RainCity Housing, including operational challenges, costs, and impacts to City services and resources; 3. Highlighting the growing problem of homelessness in the City and in the Tri- Cities, the recent decrease in shelter spaces and supportive housing, and significant gaps in housing supports to meet these growing needs; 4. Seeking Provincial commitment to fulfill their primary mandate and responsibilities in addressing homelessness, mental health and substance use issues in communities, and consideration of implementing Coquitlam’s recommended urgent priority actions resulting from the 3030 Gordon review to respond to growing community issues as outlined in this report; and 5. Indicating Coquitlam’s desire to support the Province and work with other Tri- Cities partners through a coordinated sub-regional approach toward securing additional supportive housing, mental health services and substance use services, as well as a more coordinated and comprehensive approach to outreach services in the community that are to be managed and operated by trusted service providers, where Provincial commitment on these matters has been demonstrated to the satisfaction of Council.
